title: 算術式評価器
spec: 四則演算（+ - * /）と括弧に対応した算術式評価器を実装する。文字列をトークン化し、再帰下降パーサで式を解析し、i64 で計算する。演算子の優先順位は * / が + より高い。左結合。オーバーフローは wrapping 演算で処理。0除算は DivZero エラー。構文エラー（不正な文字、括弧不一致、演算子の連続、空文字等）は Syntax エラー。数値は u32 範囲内でパースし、u32::MAX を超える場合は Syntax エラー。空白（スペース、タブ、改行）は無視する。
decl:
type bench.Cursor: pos: usize
enum bench.EvError: Alloc(alloc.alloc.AllocError), Syntax, DivZero
enum bench.Tok: Num(i64), Plus, Minus, Star, Slash, LParen, RParen
fn bench.add_op(t: bench.Tok) -> Option<u8> uses [] panics never
fn bench.mul_op(t: bench.Tok) -> Option<u8> uses [] panics never
fn bench.peek(toks: &alloc.vec.Vec<bench.Tok, std.alloc.System>, cur: &bench.Cursor) -> Option<bench.Tok> uses [] panics never
fn bench.take(toks: &alloc.vec.Vec<bench.Tok, std.alloc.System>, cur: &mut bench.Cursor) -> Option<bench.Tok> uses [] panics never
fn bench.tokenize(text: &str) -> Result<alloc.vec.Vec<bench.Tok, std.alloc.System>, bench.EvError> uses [alloc] panics never
fn bench.parse_factor(toks: &alloc.vec.Vec<bench.Tok, std.alloc.System>, cur: &mut bench.Cursor) -> Result<i64, bench.EvError> uses [] panics never stack 8192
fn bench.parse_term(toks: &alloc.vec.Vec<bench.Tok, std.alloc.System>, cur: &mut bench.Cursor) -> Result<i64, bench.EvError> uses [] panics never stack 8192
fn bench.parse_expr(toks: &alloc.vec.Vec<bench.Tok, std.alloc.System>, cur: &mut bench.Cursor) -> Result<i64, bench.EvError> uses [] panics never stack 8192
fn bench.eval(text: &str) -> Result<i64, bench.EvError> uses [alloc] panics never
